noFolder: Enter the folder where the capture frames arrive.
watchFailed: Could not start watching the folder. {message}
started: Live session started: with every new frame the stack is redone and the image is updated.
stopped: Live session stopped: {used} frames stacked out of {arrived} received.
stoppedSave: Live session stopped: {used} frames stacked out of {arrived} received. To keep the result, save the project: the Live sessions folder is suggested.
memoryProblem: Out of memory: the session stopped with {used} frames stacked.
memoryStopped: Out of memory: the live session stopped to keep StarLight from closing. Frames stacked: {used}. The result so far stays in the viewer. To resume, close other programs and start a new session.
memoryStoppedSave: Out of memory: the live session stopped to keep StarLight from closing. Frames stacked: {used}. The result so far stays in the viewer: save the project to keep it. To resume, close other programs and start a new session.

reason.calibrationFrame: calibration frame, not a light frame
